prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Miami FL to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Anthony Askowitz at RE/MAX Advance Realty
engine_stated_criteria: recent sales of homes like yours in your neighborhood
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for all of Miami—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, property type, and price range. Based on the available search results, **Joanna Jimenez at Compass** is one candidate to interview: the results report 31 seller-side transactions in the past year, across a broad range of prices. **Anthony Askowitz at RE/MAX Advance Realty** also stands out for high overall sales volume, though the figures shown aren’t specifically seller-side.

Before choosing, ask each agent for **recent sales of homes like yours in your neighborhood**, their pricing strategy and marketing plan, and a written breakdown of fees and listing-term options. Compare at least three agents, and verify their Florida license and transaction details. If you share your neighborhood, home type, and approximate value, I can help narrow down what to look for.
